a:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: a high fidelity visual concept board for the existing Mouse Frontier mobile game, landscape orientation.
Input image 1 is the actual game screenshot and is the edit reference: faithfully preserve the red steam locomotive, wooden open train carriage, small animal player, desert sunset, rails and pixel art world. Replace only the HUD/control overlays and place the resulting gameplay screen into a clean presentation board. This is a proposed menu layout, not new game art. No characters or invented dialogue.
Composition: one large landscape gameplay screenshot taking most of the board, wide 1536 by 1024-ish board. Narrow title band above and a small footer below. No photographed device or hands. Dark cocoa presentation background. Main screenshot is framed, not cropped. Accurate readable lettering.
Shared HUD for all concepts: replace the old tall two-row HUD with ONE compact dark status strip across the top of gameplay: "STOP 1", heart icon "20/20", food icon "10", water icon "10", coal icon "10", oil icon "10", "TRAIN 72%"; small labeled "PAUSE" button at upper right. Keep only essential stats in the strip. Place one large translucent movement joystick lower left. One circular "USE" contextual action lower right, distinct from the new menu controls. No obsolete MENU or BACKPACK rectangle from reference. UI uses dark brown charcoal panels, thin brass borders, large warm cream sans-serif labels, simple crisp pixel-compatible pictograms, restrained amber selection highlights. No highly ornate metal bezels. Every control icon has a short horizontal text label. Generous clear touch targets, no overlapping buttons. Preserve scenery maximum.
Concept A: a SIX-sector RADIAL QUICK MENU.
Exact title at top "A  /  RADIAL QUICK MENU". Small subtitle "One launcher • Six fixed directions".
Main screenshot shows the open wheel toward the RIGHT side, safely inside screen edges and above the separate USE button. Large round dark pie menu, exactly six broad separated wedges arranged around one central "CANCEL" circle. The six wedge labels, one per wedge, are "POSES", "LEAVE TRAIN", "TRAVEL", "BACKPACK", "MAP", "MORE". Icons respectively a seated person silhouette, exit doorway with arrow, train with arrow, bag, folded map, three dots. "POSES" wedge highlighted amber. Labels horizontal, leave train may wrap on two lines. Empty screen center and left still show train; open wheel may cover rightmost portion of carriage. No extra sectors, duplicate labels or nested rings.
Footer below screenshot: left shows a single small icon button labeled "ACTIONS" and the caption "When closed: one button". Right shows exact explanatory lines "Tap ACTIONS, then choose a direction." and "Poses opens Stand / Sit / Lay Down / Use." Smaller secondary footer "Travel opens a cost review before departure." This footer is explanatory board material outside gameplay. No second game screenshot.
